sectors.heading: Engineering Tailored to Your Asset Type
sectors.description: Every building sector has unique regulatory mandates, utility demands, and spatial constraints. We design constructible MEP systems aligned with contractor workflows.

items.title: Restaurants & Commercial Kitchens
items.desc: Commercial food service environments demand intense coordination across grease exhaust, makeup air balancing, high-volume gas distribution, and continuous plumbing sanitation.
scopes: Type I & Type II commercial kitchen hood exhaust systems
Make-Up Air (MUA) interlocks and thermal comfort balancing
Commercial grease interceptor sizing and dedicated grease waste routing
High-capacity natural gas piping schematics and pressure regulation
Health department and municipal fire marshal coordination
items.idealFor: Quick-service restaurants, fine dining, commercial ghost kitchens, brewpubs, and food hall conversions.

items.title: Commercial Office Finish-Outs & Tenant Improvements
items.desc: Tenant improvements require rapid turnaround times, constructible layouts, and flexible power and HVAC zoning to meet aggressive move-in schedules and local energy codes.
scopes: Complete MEP tenant improvement construction drawings
Title 24 / IECC automated lighting controls and occupancy sensors
Zoned VAV / VRF thermal comfort and thermostat redistribution
Flexible electrical branch circuit wiring and server room power circuits
Expedited municipal permit turnaround and plan check response
items.idealFor: Corporate headquarters finish-outs, creative agency offices, medical/dental suites, and speculative office suites.

items.title: Multifamily & Mixed-Use Residential
items.desc: Multifamily and podium developments require coordinated MEP engineering balancing individual dwelling unit comfort, acoustic isolation, centralized utilities, and common amenities.
scopes: Full-scope mechanical, electrical, and plumbing podium design
Centralized domestic hot water generation and recirculation loops
Tenant electrical submetering and utility distribution panels
Amenity clubhouse, fitness center, and co-working space MEP engineering
Enclosed parking garage carbon monoxide (CO) ventilation design
items.idealFor: Apartment communities, podium mixed-use developments, condominium complexes, and senior living facilities.

items.title: Commercial Retail & Shell Buildings
items.desc: Warm shell and vanilla box retail developments require adaptable utility stub-outs and electrical capacity that streamline future tenant fit-outs without costly structural modifications.
scopes: Speculative shell electrical service entrances and switchgear sizing
Rooftop unit curb coordination and roof penetration plans
Sanitary waste, domestic water, and natural gas stub-out coordination
Subdivision of utility metering for multi-tenant strip centers
Code-compliant exterior and parking lot photometric lighting design
items.idealFor: Boutique shopping centers, suburban retail strips, stand-alone commercial pads, and adaptive reuse retail.

items.title: HVAC Replacements & Building System Modernization
items.desc: Modernizing aging mechanical equipment extends building life, lowers peak utility costs, and ensures compliance with updated local energy codes and refrigerant standards.
scopes: Packaged Rooftop Unit (RTU) like-for-like and upgraded replacements
Heating and cooling load calculations (Manual N / ASHRAE standards)
Ductwork redistribution and static pressure re-balancing
Smart programmable thermostat and basic BAS integration
Energy code compliance documentation (COMcheck)
items.idealFor: Aging commercial buildings, schools, religious institutions, light industrial warehouses, and community facilities.
